author: _Stormz
body:
Today, I've prepared a feast for a report on Laggehh's client. In this report, I have provided links to your appetizer, main course, and dessert. Please take time to go through these. If you are not convinced, you may always go to the next dish.

Appetizer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JCk5uA7fyBY
Main Course: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yo5Lx9V9xPk&feature=youtu.be
Dessert: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrVT2eBP7r4

Furthermore, we have actually received special dishes from the chef himself, Laggehh! Straight from his YouTube channel. I would like to present these fine dishes to you. 

Special dish: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bvI-wOJLcFI

Ask DC regarding how this video shows a client. Contact him on Skype or so. He'll show you some code or so.

A note regarding KB reducers is that they disable after death. If you see clips wherein his body just flew away from where he died, that's an indicator of some sort of spooky client!

Thanks for reading
